name: Code Refactoring Workflow
description: Analyze an existing codebase, identify refactoring opportunities, plan the refactoring, and generate refactored code.

stages.name: Code Analysis
stages.description: Analyze the codebase to identify refactoring opportunities

prompts.label: Analyze Code
prompts.text:
Analyze the codebase at {{repo_path_target}} focusing on {{refactoring_focus}}. Identify:
1. Code smells and anti-patterns
2. Duplicated code
3. Complex/long methods
4. Tight coupling
5. Missing abstractions
6. Performance bottlenecks

Provide a prioritized list of refactoring opportunities.

prompts.label: Create Plan
prompts.text:
Based on the analysis, create a detailed refactoring plan. For each refactoring:
1. What to refactor
2. Which pattern/technique to apply
3. Files affected
4. Risk assessment
5. Testing strategy

Prioritize by impact and risk. Target approach: {{refactoring_approach}}.

stages.name: Generate Refactored Code
stages.description: Generate the refactored code based on the plan

prompts.label: Refactor Code
prompts.text:
Execute the refactoring plan from the previous stage. Generate the refactored code with:
1. Clear before/after comparisons
2. Explanation of each change
3. Updated imports and dependencies
4. Backward compatibility notes

Ensure all refactorings maintain existing functionality.

prompts.label: Verify Refactoring
prompts.text:
Review all the refactored code and verify:
1. No functionality was lost
2. All interfaces are preserved
3. Tests still pass conceptually
4. Edge cases are handled
5. Performance characteristics are maintained or improved

Generate a verification report.

variables.name: git_url
variables.label: Repository URL
variables.description: Git repository URL of the codebase to refactor

variables.name: refactoring_focus
variables.label: Refactoring Focus
variables.description: Specific files, modules, or areas to focus on
